verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a data export capability, whether bulk download, open-format archive, or portability tooling, for workspaces, libraries, notes, or search results. The closest items are adjacent: notes are stored as Markdown inside the workspace, which is an open format but not an export path, and enterprise customers can request deletion of organization data, which covers deletion rather than data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
